name: Demon Slayer Love and Lust
source:
A young guy lives a modest life with his mother and sister. But one day everything changes — the mother is abducted, and the sister turns into an incredibly seductive demoness.

Now the main character must find his mother, following the path of becoming — from an ordinary guy to a master of the blade and seduction. On his way there will be training sessions, battles with lustful demons, passionate meetings with unusual girls and dangerous trials.

[From [url=https://parodyman.itch.io/demon-slayer-love-and-lust]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个年轻人与他的母亲和妹妹过着简朴的生活。但有一天，一切都发生了变化——母亲被绑架了，妹妹变成了一位极其诱人的恶魔。

现在，主角必须找到他的母亲，走上成为的道路——从一个普通人到剑术和诱惑的大师。在他的途中，将会有训练课程、与好色恶魔的战斗、与不寻常女孩的热情会面以及危险的考验。

[来自[url=https://parodyman.itch.io/demon-slayer-love-and-lust]Itch.io[/url]]
